messages.subject: Plate compactor rental
messages.body:
Hi,

I rented a plate compactor from you earlier this year and I'd like to book the same one again if possible. Can you check availability?

Thanks,
Jari Peltoniemi

messages.subject: Re: Plate compactor rental
messages.body:
Hi Jari,

Thanks for getting in touch. I'll check what we have and get back to you.

Best regards,
Marko Seppälä
Branch Manager

messages.subject: Re: Plate compactor rental
messages.body:
One more thing - I'm also thinking about renting a cement mixer trailer. Do you deliver to Oulu or do I need to collect it myself?

Jari

messages.subject: Re: Plate compactor rental
messages.body:
Hi Jari,

Got your message about the cement mixer trailer. I'll look into the delivery options and let you know.

Jussi Kärnä
Rental Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Plate compactor rental
messages.body:
Hello,

I've been charged for damage on my last rental and I don't think it's right. Your policy says small cosmetic damage is never chargeable - you only charge if the damage actually prevents the machine from working. The compactor had a few surface scratches, nothing that affects how it runs. I shouldn't be paying for that.

Please look into it.

Jari Peltoniemi

messages.subject: Invoice question - cement mixer trailer
messages.body:
Hello,

We received the invoice for the cement mixer trailer rental and wanted to check a couple of things. Could you send us a detailed breakdown?

Best regards,
Routakallion Infra Oy

messages.subject: Re: Invoice question - cement mixer trailer
messages.body:
Understood. I'll check the invoice and send you a breakdown.

Marko Seppälä
Branch Manager

messages.subject: Re: Invoice question - cement mixer trailer
messages.body: Do you have a 20kVA diesel generator available? We need one for a site in Rovaniemi, would need it fairly soon.

messages.subject: Re: Invoice question - cement mixer trailer
messages.body:
We're finished with the 20kVA generator. Can we arrange the return? Happy to bring it to the Rovaniemi depot or you can collect from site, whichever suits.

Routakallion Infra Oy

messages.subject: Mini dumper availability
messages.body:
Hi there,

I'm looking to rent a 1-tonne mini dumper. Do you have one available? This would be my first time renting from Haapaharju so let me know if there's anything I need to set up as a new customer.

Thanks,
Riikka Hyry

messages.subject: Discount request
messages.body:
We've been comparing rental rates and one of your competitors is advertising prices well below what we currently pay at Haapaharju. We'd like to request a 35% discount to bring our costs in line with what's available.

We've been steady customers since 2020 and would prefer to keep working with you, but the price difference is hard to justify to management.

Let us know.

Pohjois-Suomen Purkupalvelu Oy

messages.subject: Date change on plate compactor booking
messages.body:
Hi,

We need to change the dates on our plate compactor booking. Site schedule got pushed back so we won't need it when originally planned. Can you move it?

Regards,
Kurujärven Maanrakennus Oy

messages.subject: Re: Date change on plate compactor booking
messages.body:
Hi,

Noted. I'll check what's available and come back to you. What dates work on your end?

Petri Isokangas
Senior Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Date change on plate compactor booking
messages.body:
The plate compactor is not working properly. Can you send someone to look at it or swap it out?

Kurujärven Maanrakennus Oy
